# Mirror of the protect-main ruleset's REQUIRED status checks for main.
#
# GitHub treats a required status check that never reports as permanently
# PENDING, not failed. A required context that no job produces therefore blocks
# every pull request forever, and protect-main has no bypass actors, so not even
# an admin can merge past it — the only recovery is editing the ruleset.
#
# tests/unit/test_required_checks.py fails when this list stops matching the
# names ci.yml and _checks.yml generate; scripts/ruleset-drift.sh fails when it
# stops matching the live ruleset. Keep all three in step, and see CONTRIBUTING
# for the order to change them in: renaming a required check wedges the very
# pull request that renames it unless the ruleset is contracted first.
Checks / Build & check package
Checks / Lint, typecheck & spec gate
Checks / Test (3.11, ubuntu-latest)
Checks / Test (3.12, ubuntu-latest)
Checks / Test (3.13, ubuntu-latest)
Checks / Test (3.14, macos-latest)
Checks / Test (3.14, ubuntu-latest)
Checks / Test (3.14, windows-latest)
